WELCOME TO NAKOMA!

Nakoma Swim Club extends a warm welcome to the 1978
All City Pool Meet. We hope all swimmers and spectators
will enjoy our facilities and the meet. Please understand
the importance of observing the rules and confining all
activities to the designated areas, noting specifically
that the golf course is strictly off-limits. Also, in
traveling to and from the meet, please give consideration
to the neighborhood.

As host for this meet we are endeavoring to make it
the most successful ever. The cooperation of all swimmers
and spectators. will be expected and appreciated.

The Meet Director expresses his gratitude to the
excellent committee and staff whose efforts and cooperation
are essential to a successful meet. The understanding,
support and cooperation of the Nakoma Golf Club members
is acknowledged. A special thanks is given to ALL the
pool families.

THANK YOU!

 Needlepoint made simple
    All wrapped up in needlecraft?
    A column designed especially for you will join the fea-
 tures offered in the Look Section .of Sunday's Wisconsin
 State Journal.
    It's Pat's Pointers, Pat Trexler's weekly column of imagi-
 native designs and helpful hints as well as craft kits, com-
 plete with top-grade materials and easy-to-follow instruc-
 tions. The feature will run on Sundays in The Wisconsin
 State Journal.                        \
    In the column, Mrs. Trexler also answers reader's ques-
 tions on needlecraft and offers practical advice on sweat-
 ers, pillows, toys for the children, beautiful accessories for
 your home and family.
    Now you can make them quickly and easily with direc-
 tions from an expert.
    Her introductory column Sunday offers a needlepoint kit
 for a strawberry design pillow.
    It's all in the Look Section Sunday and in all future Sun-
 days.

WELCOME TO THE CITY OF MONONA!

Monona ‘Swim Club and the City of Monona welcomes
‘all swimmers, coaches; parents, and spectators to the
1979 All City Pool Meet. It is with pride, we open our
facilities to you, and know you will give consideration
to us, by observing our rules, confining activities to
‘designated areas, and driving carefully within the
community Your cooperation is expected and appreciated.

As Meet Directors we would like to thank all
committee chairmen and staff. The success of this meet

is because of your superior efforts and cooperation.

BEST OF LUCK TO ALL SWIMMERS!!!!
